اضطلعوا (form VIII)
# اِضْطَلَعُوا (iḍṭalaʕū) /idˤ.tˤa.la.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
# اِضْطَلِعُوا (iḍṭaliʕū) /idˤ.tˤa.li.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِضْطَلَعَ (iḍṭalaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
